description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje ndertimi buze rruges kryesore.
Organizohet ne nje korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne 3 dhoma gjumi , 1 sallon dhe ambient gatimi , 1 tualet dhe 2 ballkone.
Salloni ka dalje ne ballkonin e madh. Njera prej dhomave te gjumit ka dalje ne ballkonin tjeter.
Apartamenti ka mobilim te ri cilesor dhe pamje te lire.
Me certifikate pronesie.
Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a building by the main road. It is organized in a corridor that divides it into 3 bedrooms, 1 living room and kitchen, 1 bathroom and 2 balconies. The living room has access to the large balcony. One of the bedrooms has access to the other balcony. The apartment has new quality furniture and a free view. With certificates of ownership. For a visit to the property, contact me.
